title: Eligibility-Linked Proration Rule — Months Covered by the RideLink Yearly Allotment
content:
The yearly Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added allotment is loaded for the months of coverage the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership is expected to have in the year.

**Rule.** The load covers the months of coverage expected in the year: when the active plan membership is in Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, records no termination date and has its renewal due date within the benefit year, the load covers the whole months from January through the renewal due month; when the membership records a termination date within the benefit year, it covers the whole months from January through the termination month; otherwise it covers all twelve months. The trips loaded are the full-year allotment — every trip the year's allotment carries for twelve months — times the covered months, divided by twelve and rounded down to a whole trip.

## Branches, taken in order

| Test on the active membership | Months covered |
|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, no termination date, renewal due date in the benefit year | January through the renewal due month |
| Otherwise: a termination date in the benefit year | January through the termination month |
| Otherwise | 12 |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical benefit year, full-year allotment of 27 trips:*

| Membership | Months covered | Trips loaded |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, renewal due 15 July, no termination date | 7 | 27 times 7, divided by 12, is 15.75, rounded down to 15 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care, termination date 30 April | 4 | 27 times 4, divided by 12, is 9 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, renewal due in the next year | 12 | 27 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, renewal due in September and termination date in May | 5 | 27 times 5, divided by 12, is 11.25, rounded down to 11 |
